transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions without knowing the true prevalence, transmission rate, and geographic spread of this virus; aggressive early testing is the highest-leverage action available.

actions.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions without knowing the true prevalence, transmission rate, and geographic spread of this virus; aggressive early testing is the highest-leverage action available.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions is a proportional, reversible measure that slows the introduction of new cases and buys time for our domestic response to scale.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions is a proportional, reversible measure that slows the introduction of new cases and buys time for our domestic response to scale.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Global demand for PPE, tests, and ventilators will skyrocket; securing domestic production now prevents catastrophic shortages later when we may need them most.

actions.rationale: Global demand for PPE, tests, and ventilators will skyrocket; securing domestic production now prevents catastrophic shortages later when we may need them most.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has the longest lead time of any response tool; starting a crash program now is the only way to have options in months rather than years.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has the longest lead time of any response tool; starting a crash program now is the only way to have options in months rather than years.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Daily data-driven briefings build public trust and credibility now, which will be essential if harder measures become necessary later.

actions.rationale: Daily data-driven briefings build public trust and credibility now, which will be essential if harder measures become necessary later.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives states, hospitals, and citizens the real-time situational awareness they need to make local decisions.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives states, hospitals, and citizens the real-time situational awareness they need to make local decisions.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Emergency funding and statutory authority will be needed for testing, supply procurement, vaccine development, and potential economic relief; engaging Congress now ensures we're not delayed when speed matters most.

actions.rationale: Emergency funding and statutory authority will be needed for testing, supply procurement, vaccine development, and potential economic relief; engaging Congress now ensures we're not delayed when speed matters most.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 7/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, high-impact intervention that slows transmission without shutting down the economy; with exponential growth underway, even modest reduction in spread rate compounds significantly.

actions.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, high-impact intervention that slows transmission without shutting down the economy; with exponential growth underway, even modest reduction in spread rate compounds significantly.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Targeted protection of elderly and high-risk individuals saves lives at minimal economic cost and is the prudent move while severity data remains uncertain.

actions.rationale: Targeted protection of elderly and high-risk individuals saves lives at minimal economic cost and is the prudent move while severity data remains uncertain.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Markets are already skittish and further measures may be needed; pre-positioning economic relief prevents panic, supports households facing disruption, and gives us fiscal credibility for tougher decisions ahead.

actions.rationale: Markets are already skittish and further measures may be needed; pre-positioning economic relief prevents panic, supports households facing disruption, and gives us fiscal credibility for tougher decisions ahead.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust at 58 needs reinforcement; continuing transparent daily briefings with the new data keeps the public informed and prepared for potential escalation.

actions.rationale: Public trust at 58 needs reinforcement; continuing transparent daily briefings with the new data keeps the public informed and prepared for potential escalation.

transcript.sitrep:
DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

SITUATION (Week 3). Estimated infection index 3.0 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 101/100. Public trust 61/100. Hospital strain 11/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 58/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: Exponential growth across a dozen states with no containment in sight means waiting another week could mean the difference between a manageable surge and system collapse; acting now while the economy is strong and hospital strain is still low is the prudent course.

actions.rationale: Exponential growth across a dozen states with no containment in sight means waiting another week could mean the difference between a manageable surge and system collapse; acting now while the economy is strong and hospital strain is still low is the prudent course.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: A lockdown will immediately disrupt households and small businesses; robust economic relief must accompany the guidance to sustain public compliance and prevent a cascading economic crisis.

actions.rationale: A lockdown will immediately disrupt households and small businesses; robust economic relief must accompany the guidance to sustain public compliance and prevent a cascading economic crisis.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: We are asking the country for a significant sacrifice; the public deserves a clear, honest explanation of the data, the reasoning, and what success looks like to maintain trust at this critical inflection point.

actions.rationale: We are asking the country for a significant sacrifice; the public deserves a clear, honest explanation of the data, the reasoning, and what success looks like to maintain trust at this critical inflection point.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: With spread now nationwide, we need maximum testing and genomic surveillance to identify hotspots, track the trajectory, and know when it's safe to ease restrictions.

actions.rationale: With spread now nationwide, we need maximum testing and genomic surveillance to identify hotspots, track the trajectory, and know when it's safe to ease restrictions.
